locations.note: On the eve of the battle Musashi is sent to kill a supposed traitor in the Tokugawa camp, who turns out to be the clan heir Yūki Hideyasu.
Beyond Gion's walls Kiryu works the rough outskirts of Rakugai and joins the Yoshioka Dojo to meet the false Musashi.
Under the alias Kiryu Kazumanosuke, Musashi guards the Tsuruya brothel in walled Gion and takes young Haruka's job to kill the impostor using his old name.
Kiryu confronts Majima, who has carried Haruka off to the temple; Sasaki Kojirō strikes, and the old man with them reveals himself as Tokugawa Ieyasu, Haruka's grandfather.
Kiryu duels Sasaki Kojirō on the island and holds off Tenkai's army so Haruka can get away.

routes.name: Musashi's road
routes.note: From the Tokugawa camp at Sekigahara to a hidden life in Gion and the final duel on Ganryū-jima.
